notes.1: Many candidates appreciated that sensitivity is a characteristic of living things, although a number incorrectly opted for breathing, perhaps confusing it with respiration.
notes.3: This proved to be a challenging question. The number of candidates selecting each option suggests that many candidates were unsure that having two pairs of legs on each segment is a feature of some myriapods.
notes.6: Many candidates were able to calculate the actual size of the nucleus. Some candidates did not appreciate that to work out the actual size of the nucleus, the image size of the nucleus needed to be divided by the magnification.
notes.12: This proved to be a demanding question. Only areas of the leaf that possess chlorophyll would have starch and turn blue-black. The white areas of the leaf would be the same colour as the iodine which is yellow- brown.
notes.15: This proved to be a demanding question. There was a misconception that sugars dissolve the enamel of the teeth. Bacteria respire the sugar and produce acid, which dissolves the enamel.
notes.17: Only a minority of candidates appreciated that water evaporates from the surface of the spongy mesophyll cells and then diffuses out of the stomata.
notes.18: The effect of temperature and humidity on the movement of dye up a plant stem was not well understood by many candidates, perhaps missing the link to transpiration.
notes.19: Many candidates appreciated that the blood vessels that take blood into the heart are the pulmonary vein and the vena cava.
notes.20: Few candidates correctly identified the blood vessel as an artery, often confusing it with a vein.
notes.22: While most candidates responded correctly, some incorrectly believed that the depth of breathing decreased.
notes.23: Very few candidates appreciated that respiration involves enzymes.
notes.24: There was some uncertainty about anaerobic respiration in muscles. Lactic acid is the only product.
notes.25: Candidates needed to appreciate that at the higher temperature, the student would be sweating more and therefore producing less urine. This item proved to be challenging for many candidates.
notes.34: Most candidates incorrectly believed that meiosis occurs when a reptile regrows its tail. Mitosis is used for growth and tissue repair.
notes.38: Many candidates found it difficult to apply their understanding of the term population to the contexts in the question.
notes.39: While many candidates appreciated what is involved in genetic engineering, some incorrectly believed that genetic engineering was the breeding of sheep with thick wool by choosing animals with desired characteristics.
notes.general_comments:
There was good understanding of: where most of the absorption of digested food takes place; the function of
white blood cells; that asexual reproduction only requires one parent; the role of testosterone; what is meant
by an adaptive feature of an organism, and the effects of deforestation.
There was some uncertainty about: breathing as a characteristic of living things; the characteristics of
myriapods; the fact that respiration involves enzymes; the products of anaerobic respiration in muscles.
It is important for candidates to work carefully and methodically through information provided in the question.
